tell veiwers how node sizes can be changed

To adjust the size of a node on the canvas:

1. Click and drag the bottom-right corner of the node. Dragging inward shrinks it, dragging outward enlarges it. 
2. For more precise sizing, right-click the node and select "Edit Node" > "Size" from the context menu. A slider will appear allowing you to set the exact width and height values.
3. You can also double-click the node label and type a new name with larger text, which will automatically resize the node to fit the new label size.

These steps work the same way regardless of the platform or canvas you're using.

tell people about node size adhustable

Node sizes in the canvas are fully adjustable. Each node can be resized by dragging its edges. There's no fixed minimum or maximum; you can make nodes as tiny or as large as needed to fit your layout. If you want a specific node to be a certain size, simply grab its corners and drag them.
